tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Full-frame paper pages (title card, map), with paper grain.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Place tags and torn caption strips over footage, with paper grain and a drop shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Typewriter text on paper. Also the fill of the destination label.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Coordinates and datelines.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Red marker: handwritten notes, the route and its two pins. Nothing else.

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: Yellow highlighter behind the key words of a line. One run per line at most.

tokens.name: land
tokens.usage: Land fill on the map.

tokens.name: coast
tokens.usage: Coastlines on the map, 3 px.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Map grid lines at 50% opacity, 1.5 px.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of tags and headlines on a 1080-wide frame.

tokens.name: caption-top
tokens.usage: Top of the caption strip on a 1920-tall frame: below the face, above the app buttons.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep all text at least this far from every frame edge.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Tags, strips and polaroids have square corners. Strips have torn top and bottom edges.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: tags, strips and the polaroid arriving. GSAP: power3.out.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits: leave fast. GSAP: power2.in.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: The route drawing from A to B. GSAP: power2.inOut.

tokens.name: type
tokens.usage: Time per letter when a headline types on.

tokens.name: write
tokens.usage: One line of marker note writing itself on, left to right (sine.inOut).

tokens.name: stick
tokens.usage: A tag or polaroid dropping on and settling to its tilt.

tokens.name: strip
tokens.usage: A caption strip slapping on. Cut out, no fade.

tokens.name: exit
tokens.usage: About half an entrance.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum time a line stays still to be read.
